name: Dura-Ace rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 2001 reference: RD-7700 short-cage, nine-speed rear derailleur. The weight is from the catalogue; the retained capacity is from the cited service instructions.

technical_document.title: Shimano RD-7700 exploded view and replacement parts

sources.title: Shimano RD-7700 exploded view and replacement parts
Shimano rear derailleur service instructions SI-5TJ1G

specifications.catalogue_capacity_note: The 2001 catalogue lists 29T total capacity; service instruction SI-5TJ1G lists 26T. The existing service-instruction limit is retained rather than treating the sources as interchangeable.
